description: This file defines the Role class for Drupal's user module, representing user roles with permissions, weight, and admin status, including methods for managing permissions and dependencies.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a user role entity with permissions, weight, and admin status, including methods for permission management and dependency calculation.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns permissions for the role, empty if role is admin.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the role has a specific permission.

methods.name: grantPermission
methods.description: Adds a permission to the role.

methods.name: revokePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission from the role.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the role is an admin role.

methods.name: setIsAdmin
methods.description: Sets the admin status of the role.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Sorts roles by weight after loading.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Prepares the role entity before saving, including setting weight and sorting permissions.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates dependencies based on permissions and modules.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Removes permissions dependent on deleted modules or dependencies.
